title: PR request on completed work's manifest
description:
A work completes carrying a result manifest: when the STORED manifest (ref + digest on the event, verified-bytes law) names a prRequest with repo+head, ask the VCS for a change request (vcs.change_request.create as a routing intent from the completed work, effect-key base branch:, pending-PR marker binding parked); then, per structuredResult.commentRequests[] element, comment (fan-out, vcs.change_request.comment) - both legs can run, as the arm's dispatch did. No manifest request: settle with no VCS effect. Deterministic guard ladder, no model consulted; the capability ids live here, not in code constants. Provider-agnostic by design: enable per provider through a scoped copy (source='derived', team set, provider token baked into the binding). The trigger requires a manifest ref on the event; a scoped copy adds a first-step guard on `assign.capability` (the completing assignment's capability, read from the assign envelope row). The gallery shape triggers on every completed manifest WITHOUT an assign-capability guard (a manifest with no requests settles silently); a scoped copy inserts a first guard step on `assign.capability` (the completing assignment's capability, read from the assign envelope row), bakes the binding provider token, and sets `team`. The Providers:

:PrRequestCapability option imports exactly that copy.
